## FSM transitions

### DEVICE

- (new) --PAIR--> ACTIVE
- ACTIVE --REVOKE--> REVOKED
- REVOKED --REINSTATE--> ACTIVE

### PAIRING

- (new) --ISSUE--> ISSUED
- ISSUED --CLAIM--> CLAIMED
- ISSUED --CANCEL--> CANCELLED

### TRANSFER

- (new) --CREATE--> RECEIVING
- RECEIVING --STAGE--> READY
- READY --DELIVER--> DELIVERED
- RECEIVING --FAIL--> FAILED
- READY --FAIL--> FAILED
- RECEIVING --CANCEL--> CANCELLED
- READY --CANCEL--> CANCELLED
- RECEIVING --EXPIRE--> EXPIRED
- READY --EXPIRE--> EXPIRED
